React · Redux & state management

How would you manage global state in a large-scale application?

Answer

  • Separate state types: server state (API data) → RTK Query / React Query; global client state (auth, preferences, cart) → Redux Toolkit; local UI state → useState; URL state → router query params; form state → React Hook Form.
  • Organize Redux by feature slices (features/cart/cartSlice.js), not by file type.
  • Normalize data (by id, createEntityAdapter) to avoid duplication.
  • Use memoized selectors and keep components subscribed to the smallest slice.
  • Keep state minimal; derive values with selectors instead of storing them.
  • Lazy-load reducers for large / micro-frontend apps; use TypeScript for typed state and actions.
